query:

  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN productId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sem_vinculo,
  SUM(CASE WHEN productId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as com_vinculo
FROM ifoodProductMappings;
